requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(FLAG, X) reports same-kind exception detection support
requirements.source: S17.11.55 p5 result value; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF509.
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(FLAG, X) is true exactly for the specified exception and real kind type parameter where detection of that exception is supported; otherwise it is false.

pending.ieee_support_flag-flag-x-detection-suppo: Guarded branch plan: for each listed flag and instantiated real kind rk, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,1.0_rk), IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,[1.0_rk]), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0_rk); assert scalar and array probes agree. True branch runs the named preamble FLAG_HALTING_OFF(flag): under IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag), call IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,.FALSE.) and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag) to assert .FALSE.; without halting support, call IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag) under its own guard and continue only in the observed .FALSE. branch, with the .TRUE. branch recorded as skip. Before each exception row, clear IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT with IEEE_SET_FLAG only for flags whose IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,1.0_rk) probe is true, then assert those cleared flags are quiet with IEEE_GET_FLAG. Execute the matching operation for the row (0.0_rk/0.0_rk invalid, HUGE(1.0_rk)*HUGE(1.0_rk) overflow, 1.0_rk/0.0_rk divide-by-zero, TINY(1.0_rk)*TINY(1.0_rk) underflow, 1.0_rk/3.0_rk inexact), and assert IEEE_GET_FLAG reports the target flag set under that target flag support probe; no other-flag quiet assertion is claimed from 17.11.55 because this section specifies detection support for the selected exception, not exclusivity of the generated operation. False branch records skip for detection effects.
